clips.title: The story
paras: Sargeras is the fallen titan and supreme creator of the Burning Legion, bent on scouring all life from the cosmos. Once the noble champion and defender of the Pantheon, his descent into madness led to the Sundering of ancient Azeroth and nearly every demonic catastrophe since.

Before his fall, Sargeras was the greatest and noblest warrior among the titans. Entrusted by the Pantheon of Order to safeguard their grand creations across the Great Dark Beyond, he waged war against the chaotic demons spawned from the Twisting Nether. Incapable of conceiving pure evil, Sargeras trapped countless fiends away within a great prison. Yet eons of relentless warfare against cosmic horrors gradually wore down his altruistic spirit.
